[[Emirates Club|Emirates]] | highest attendance = [[Al Ain FC|Al-Ain]] vs. [[Al Wahda FC|Al-Wahda]] (18,126) | lowest attendance = [[Dibba Al Fujairah FC|Dibba Al Fujairah]] vs. [[Al-Shaab CSC|Al-Shaab]] (168) | average attendance = 2,557 | prevseason = [[2014–15 UAE Pro League|2014–15]] | nextseason = [[2016–17 UAE Pro League|2016–17]] }} The '''2015–16 [[UAE Pro League]]''' (also known as '''Arabian Gulf League''' for sponsorship reasons) was the 41st top-level football season in the [[United Arab Emirates]]. Fourteen teams participated with [[Al Ain FC|Al-Ain]] as the defending champions after securing the championship last season for the twelfth time.
